title: Ten years, ten rings
label: The cut end of a log rising from the bottom edge as a half circle, heartwood at the centre of the bottom edge and bark round the top. Rings grow outward one per year from the founding year, 2017, to today, 2026, and each year is written on its ring up the middle of the slice. As a ring finishes, a pin on it draws a leader out to the side and labels that year's moment, alternating left and right: founded in a spare room in Lisbon in 2017, the first paying customer in 2018, a $4M seed round in 2020, a second office in Toronto in 2021, a team of 60 in 2023 and customers in 30 countries in 2024. The outermost ring, 2026, is today: it flushes with the accent colour and a leader climbs from it to a card reading 140 people, in Lisbon, Toronto and remote.
heading:
Ten years,
one ring at a time.
sub: We started in a spare room in 2017. Each ring is a year, and these are the moments that shaped them.
